decisions.decision: JIRA-01 (configure the Jira Cloud site) moved from Phase 2 into Phase 1
decisions.rationale: AUTH-01 cannot validate a token without knowing the site — inseparable. ROADMAP.md and REQUIREMENTS.md traceability both updated.

decisions.decision: A valid Jira API token for the configured site is sufficient to authenticate (D-01/D-02)
decisions.rationale: No allowlist, no group check, no separate user store. Write-side access is deliberately unscoped; accepted risk for an internal tool. Upgrade path is a Jira group check at sign-in — do not build it now.

decisions.decision: Record the acting user on every state change; build no role model (D-03)
decisions.rationale: Keeps an audit trail and lets roles be added later without a data migration.

decisions.decision: Stateless JWT in an httpOnly/Secure/SameSite cookie + Spring Security CSRF (D-05/D-08)
decisions.rationale: Statelessness without the XSS exposure of localStorage; same-origin single-jar deployment makes CSRF protection necessary.

decisions.decision: Jira token persisted with column-level encryption, key from env/mounted secret, key version recorded per row (D-10..D-13)
decisions.rationale: AUTH-03 requires a DB connection alone not expose plaintext. No cloud KMS dependency in Phase 1; key-version field makes later rotation/migration tolerable. Token is never returned to the client — replacement only.

decisions.decision: All external access is user-triggered — no background jobs (D-14)
decisions.rationale: Keeps the audit trail unambiguous about who caused each external call.

decisions.decision: Enable the research agent and set granularity to standard in .planning/config.json
decisions.rationale: Phase 1 establishes precedent for all seven phases (architecture boundaries, error shape, crypto) — coarse planning without research is too thin for that.
